item.title: He tried his best to build an accessible guitar
item.description: Asfvision is Anthony S. Ferraro, he advocates for less sighted people by doing skateboarding, sports, and arts. Nvision guitars specializes in building custom guitars for people with less sight, including tactile fret markers, textured knobs, and ergonomic bodies. https://nvisionguitarsllc.square.site/ By engineering for those with less abilities and resources, we end up finding universal aids that help everyone. As a guitarist, I know many of us would love tactile necks to not look down as much, if we play live in the dark, and just to learn without visually checking which frets we are on. Not an ad, no association with either party in this video, just sharing the love

item.title: GovBrief Today #586
item.description: A Border Patrol analyst in Spokane read a stranger's bank activity, and a Montana trooper found a reason to pull him over. Nobody knows how a federal agent in Washington and a state trooper in Montana came to be talking about one black Chevy on Interstate 90, because the government won't say. We know it happened only because the paperwork surfaced in his court case. The analyst's memo says he saw "financial activity patterns" in federal databases and put the car out as a lookout. On bodycam, the trooper told the driver it was "nothing major," just a plate cover. The Spokane unit is called the Predictive Intelligence Targeting Team, and true to its name, it exists to predict whether you might be doing something illegal. Customs and Border Protection will not say what financial records it reads, whether a warrant is involved, or how many of its 20 sectors participate. In Texas the same program had a deputy search a driver's truck on a lane-drift stop and find nothing. That driver was never charged. item.title: Ok last pic for this Pink Wednesday
item.description:
I finally went out to see a former co-worker and drove my newly purchased car on the freeway. My god the freedom to move when you want whenever you want must not be taken for granted. Anyway she is an older lady in her 60's, super sweet, takes the bus to work duper hardworking even though she has a hard time walking so I was delighted to pick her up and finally catch up with her. We just discussed so much and cried and laughed and went to Michaels to look at crafts and then Walmart as she wanted to make a lemon blueberry cake (never thought I'd say I missed Walmart.) It was so nice to feel normal and independant again and she was so happy to see me and be driven somewhere. I know I am repetative but my gratitude for what you all did to help get me back here and start over and BELIEVED in me and my crazy story I can never thank you enough.
I found this cute plush throw at Burlington to cover my backseat and bring me some joy. I MEAN LOOK HOW FREAKING CUTE IT IS!!! It was the last one for $9.99 so I had to get it. My little treat for the month. I hope you all find something to make you smile or sparkle this week and the holiday season to come. *Edit: I STILL AM BANNED FROM CHAT AND NO REPLY TO MY APPEALS. I will post more about my Halloween and Christmas card giveaway in the days and weeks to come on my other account.
